description: This file defines structures and functions related to configuring a talk provider, including parsing configuration dictionaries, resolving provider IDs, and handling default and fallback logic for provider selection.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts a raw dictionary with key-value pairs from [String: Any] to [String: AnyCodable].

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects and returns a TalkProviderConfigSelection based on input talk configuration dictionary, default provider, and fallback allowance.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an integer timeout value from an AnyCodable, with fallback and validation.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout in milliseconds from the talk configuration, with fallback.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the provider configuration into a TalkProviderConfigSelection, if available.
